summary: This plugin is a DeepSeek Harness todo-based turn gate that checks task state at turn stop, can continue the turn when unfinished work remains, and issues configurable reminders when there are no recent todos or todo lists go stale.

classificationSuggestion.reason: This plugin is a workflow-oriented DeepSeek Harness extension that helps users keep turn-based agent sessions aligned with task tracking: it inspects the latest todo snapshot at turn-stop, blocks end-of-turn progression for unfinished non-waiting items, and prompts on prolonged absence or staleness of todo updates. The behavior and thresholds are user-configurable in a web settings section, with scope limited to conversation control messaging.
